items.title: Isaiah Likely's 66-yard TD has Giants leading, puts him over 100 yards
items.text: Isaiah Likely has a career high, with 127 yards on nine catches.

items.title: Justin Jefferson: It's a joy to see Kirk Cousins take over as a leader
items.text: Kirk Cousins is back in Minnesota, and perhaps no one is more excited about that than Justin Jefferson.

items.title: Commanders back in front of Giants, 17-14
items.text: The Commanders answered the Giants with a six-play, 77-yard drive.

items.title: Cam Skattebo gives Giants a 14-10 lead
items.text: Cam Skattebo has his second touchdown, and the Giants lead for the second time.

items.title: Report: Rex Ryan incident was captured on camera
items.text: The recent news that Rex Ryan, of all people, allegedly ran over, of all the things, the feet of a pair of pedestrians in Nashville seems too crazy to be true, absent visual evidence.

items.title: Thursday Night Football: Commanders lead Giants 10-7 at halftime
items.text: Ben Sinnott caught a 1-yard touchdown pass from Jayden Daniels with 5 seconds remaining in the first half.

items.title: Rams place WR Puka Nacua on IR
items.text: Nacua injured the MCL and PCL in his knee and has turf toe.

items.title: Justin Herbert is not on Chargers' injury report as they begin prep for Ravens
items.text: Justin Herbert injured the middle finger on his left hand in Sunday's loss to the Texans.

items.title: Seahawks LT Charles Cross practices for the first time since Week 7
items.text: The Seahawks had their starting left tackle back at practice on Thursday.

items.title: Thursday Night Football: Giants LB Malik Harrison is inactive
items.text: The Commanders and Giants had no surprises among their inactives.

items.title: Dre Greenlaw, Trent Williams were limited in Thursday's practice
items.text: 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw and left tackle Trent Williams rested during Wednesday's practice, but they had different listings on Thursday's practice report.

items.title: DeMarvion Overshown didn't know inactive players couldn't celebrate on the field
items.text: The Cowboys had 14 accepted penalties for 153 yards in the 27-23 win over the Colts.

items.title: Ravens list Rashod Bateman, Vega Ioane as limited in Thursday's practice
items.text: Everyone on the Ravens' active roster practiced on Thursday, but a handful of them were limited participants.

items.title: David Montgomery returns to Texans practice; Woody Marks, Marvin Harrison Jr. don't practice
items.text: The Texans had running back David Montgomery back on the practice field on Thursday, but they were missing a couple of other key offensive players.

items.title: Knoxville, Chattanooga Fox affiliates pass on Titans game, for now
items.text: The Tennessee Titans apparently need an asterisk on their name.

items.title: Jaguars get Jakobi Meyers, Travon Walker back at practice
items.text: The Jaguars got a couple of their top players back on the practice field on Thursday.

items.title: George Pickens limited again Thursday
items.text: Cowboys wide receiver George Pickens remained a limited participant on Thursday.

items.title: Jared Goff listed as full participant at Thursday's practice
items.text: Lions quarterback Jared Goff was listed as a limited participant in practice on Wednesday, but it doesn't look like there will be an issue with his availability for Sunday's game against the Patriots.

items.title: Jim Harbaugh: Broncos took advantage of a loophole the NFL should not allow
items.text: The Chargers' head coach is not happy with the Broncos trying to renegotiate the trade for Daiyan Henley after the deadline, or with the NFL allowing it.

items.title: Joey Porter Jr.: Injuries keeping me off field, not my contract situation
items.text: Porter missed practice again on Thursday with an ankle injury.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson returns to practice, A.J. Brown remains limited
items.text: The Patriots had some positive news on their injury report from Thursday's reportedly light practice in Munich.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes on Josh Downs: You can tell the intellect, how he can pick things up
items.text: The Chiefs brought in a receiver at the trading deadline, acquiring Josh Downs from the Colts.

items.title: Vikings re-sign Odell Beckham Jr. to practice squad
items.text: Wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. is back with the Vikings.

items.title: Jacoby Brissett: The last week has definitely been a crash course
items.text: Jacoby Brissett has been a member of the Ravens for less than a week, but he's set to start at quarterback in the team's game against the Chargers on Monday night.

items.title: Kirk Cousins will wear No. 8 again for Vikings
items.text: Vikings fans won't need to buy new Kirk Cousins jerseys.

items.title: Christian Gonzalez: I'm going into Sunday with the same confidence I always have
items.text: Patriots cornerback Christian Gonzalez is coming off a terrible game against the Packers, but he said on Thursday that it won't be hanging over his head in Munich this Sunday.

items.title: Failed Daiyan Henley trade exposes a flaw in the NFL's trade deadline
items.text: The trade deadline is the trade deadline.

items.title: Denzel Boston remains out of Thursday's practice with toe injury
items.text: On Wednesday, Browns head coach Todd Monken said he was anticipating rookie receiver Denzel Boston would practice on Thursday.

items.title: Jared Verse upset with how he's playing, met with team psychiatrist about "mental block"
items.text: Browns defensive end Jared Verse still doesn't have a sack this season, and he says his struggles are more mental than physical.

items.title: Report: Chiefs, 49ers showed interest in trading for Garrett Wilson
items.text: The Chiefs and 49ers both traded for a receiver at this week's deadline, as Kansas City acquired Josh Downs and San Francisco brought in Keenan Allen.
